name: contract-case-realpath
goal: Retain actual runner case outcomes when snapshot and runner paths resolve to the same source

evidence: macOS snapshot root and runner filepath can use /var and /private/var for the same tree, so valid results are discarded and strict verification reports a missing case.
Existing configured reporter method cases use identical lexical root and file paths. Strengthen them and the existing generated-library case with real symlinked roots and outside files.
